mc-nav-003.front: Does BC charge you for a search and rescue?
mc-nav-003.back: No. "You don't pay to be rescued" (95%, BCSARA report); NSR: no cost for rescue (75%).

mc-nav-012.back: Agencies such as police, BC Ambulance, fire services. You call 911 (95%, BCSARA).

mc-nav-013.front: Box yourself in: the 3 kinds of lines?
mc-nav-013.back: Baseline you can always walk back to; handrails on the sides; a backstop you never cross (Tip, built on orienteering, 85%).
